questions.stem: A rectangle has a perimeter of 46 cm. Its length is 15 cm. What is the width?
questions.explanation: P = 2(l + w). So 46 = 2(15 + w), giving 23 = 15 + w, so w = 8 cm.

questions.stem: A regular hexagon has a perimeter of 54 cm. What is the length of each side?
questions.explanation: A regular hexagon has 6 equal sides. Each side = 54 / 6 = 9 cm.

A square has the same perimeter as a rectangle with length 12 cm and width 6 cm. What is the side length of the square?
questions.explanation: Rectangle perimeter = 2(12 + 6) = 36 cm. Square perimeter = 4s = 36, so s = 9 cm.
